name: Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) / Deep Belief Network (DBN)
when_to_use: Unsupervised/generative learning for images (reconstruction) and multiclass classification (e.g., MNIST/Fashion-MNIST digits); multilevel categorical dependent variable.
notes: Depends on the RBM package installed via devtools::install_github("TimoMatzen/RBM") — it is not on CRAN, not a standard installation.

expected_input.question: How to learn unsupervised representations of images?
expected_input.note: Needs adaptation before running (see the notes field).

plain_explanation.purpose: Network that learns hidden patterns in the data on its own, with no labeled response needed.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: To extract features automatically before classifying, or to study the subject.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A numeric table of factors, with no response column required.
plain_explanation.example: Discover recurring purchase patterns before building a model.
plain_explanation.diagram: data -> layers that summarize what repeats -> compact representation
